title: Bells and note blocks
body:
Note Blocks have been (re)added.

Gone are the days of using odd blocks for note block music. Who wants to use soul sand, or something as expensive as an iron block, for a single note? Now you just make a Bell out of gold, and each type of bell has a different instrument assigned to it.

One side effect: since Note Blocks and their sounds didn't exist in 2010, every Note Block instrument is now a MIDI instrument.

![image: Bells and note blocks](media/1421408803173433475.png)
![image: Bells and note blocks](media/1421408803630481549.png)

There will be 6 more instruments than shown here, three of them drums. The design of the Note Block itself may also change.
